product.name: Kettle
product.tagline: Booking, memberships and payments for independent fitness studios.

stack.web-member: Member booking site and embeddable widget (Next.js)
stack.mobile: Member & instructor app (React Native, iOS + Android)
stack.integrations: Payment processor, SMS, email, calendars, accounting

product.team: Eight humans supervise four build agents, one review agent and one ops agent.

milestones.name: Public beta
milestones.goal: First 100 paying studios can run their whole timetable and memberships on Kettle.

milestones.name: Payments GA
milestones.goal: Kettle processes all studio payments end-to-end: dunning, tax, bank debit, payouts reconciled.

milestones.name: Multi-location
milestones.goal: Studio chains with several locations run from one account.

milestones.name: Kettle Assistant
milestones.goal: AI that fills classes and keeps members: schedule suggestions, chat booking, churn outreach.

features.name: Email & password sign-in
features.summary: Members and staff sign in with email and password.

features.name: Magic-link login
features.summary: Passwordless sign-in through a one-time email link.

features.name: Google sign-in
features.summary: Sign in with a Google account.

features.name: Apple sign-in
features.summary: Sign in with Apple, required for the iOS app store.

features.name: Two-factor auth for staff
features.summary: Staff accounts protect payouts and member data with a second factor.

features.name: Sessions & device list
features.summary: See and revoke signed-in devices.

features.name: Staff roles & permissions
features.summary: Owner, manager, front desk and instructor roles with fixed permissions.

features.name: Custom role builder
features.summary: Studios define their own roles from individual permissions.

features.name: Multi-studio account switching
features.summary: One login moves between studios and locations.

features.name: Audit log
features.summary: Every sensitive staff action recorded and searchable.

notes.text: SOC 2 and GDPR erasure both depend on this.

features.name: Studio onboarding wizard
features.summary: Guided setup: studio, rooms, classes, prices, payments in 20 minutes.

features.name: Member import from CSV
features.summary: Bring an existing member list in from a spreadsheet.

features.name: Legacy system migration
features.summary: One-click import of members, plans and history from the two incumbent studio systems.

notes.text: Asked in 38 sales calls this month. Most-requested thing we do not have.

features.name: Branding & theme editor
features.summary: Logo, colours and fonts for the booking page and member app.

features.name: Custom booking domain
features.summary: Booking page on the studio's own domain with managed certificates.

features.name: Locations & rooms
features.summary: Rooms with capacity and layout per location.

features.name: Multi-location management
features.summary: Chains manage several locations, shared plans and cross-location booking.

features.name: Equipment & resource booking
features.summary: Reserve reformers, bikes or courts as resources.

features.name: Opening hours & holidays
features.summary: Hours, closures and holiday schedules that block bookings.

features.name: Class types catalog
features.summary: Class types with description, level, duration and default capacity.

features.name: Recurring class schedule
features.summary: Weekly repeating classes with exceptions.

features.name: Drag-and-drop timetable editor
features.summary: Move and resize classes directly on the week grid.

features.name: Schedule templates
features.summary: Save a season's timetable and roll it out again.

features.name: Class capacity rules
features.summary: Capacity, minimum attendance and auto-cancel of empty classes.

features.name: Substitute instructor swap
features.summary: Swap an instructor and notify booked members.

features.name: 1:1 appointments
features.summary: Members book private sessions with an instructor.

features.name: Instructor availability
features.summary: Instructors publish the hours they can take appointments.

features.name: Buffers & travel time
features.summary: Gaps between appointments and travel time between locations.

features.name: Small-group private sessions
features.summary: Private sessions for 2 to 4 people sharing one booking.

features.name: Workshops & events
features.summary: One-off events with their own pricing and capacity.

features.name: Multi-session courses
features.summary: Six-week courses booked and paid as one.

features.name: Virtual classes
features.summary: Livestream link delivered to booked members before class.

features.name: Book a class
features.summary: Members reserve a spot in two taps.

features.name: Cancellation & late-cancel policy
features.summary: Cancel windows, late-cancel fees and credit returns.

features.name: Waitlist with auto-promote
features.summary: When a spot frees up, the next member on the waitlist is booked and told.

notes.text: INC-212: two members promoted into the same last spot at 7am rush. Race in the promote job. Hotfix holds, real fix in PR.
Three studios asked this week whether the double-booking is fixed.

features.name: Spot selection
features.summary: Pick your mat, bike or reformer from the room layout.

business.usageNote: Used in 71% of bookings at studios that have it.

features.name: Book for friends & family
features.summary: Book and pay for a guest or a family member.

features.name: Recurring auto-booking
features.summary: Members hold their usual weekly class automatically.

notes.text: Members of three big studios churn citing "had to rebook every week".

features.name: QR check-in
features.summary: Members scan a code at the door.

features.name: Front-desk check-in kiosk
features.summary: A tablet at the desk with search, check-in and walk-in sales.

notes.text: Touch targets too small, contrast fails. Built from a wireframe, never had a hi-fi pass.

features.name: No-show tracking & penalties
features.summary: Count no-shows and apply the studio's penalty rules.

features.name: Attendance history
features.summary: Members and staff see every visit.

features.name: Membership plans
features.summary: Monthly and annual unlimited or capped memberships.

features.name: Class packs & credits
features.summary: Packs of 5, 10 or 20 classes with expiry.

features.name: Intro offers
features.summary: First-week and first-month offers for new members.

features.name: Family plans
features.summary: One payer, several members, shared or separate credits.

features.name: Freeze & pause membership
features.summary: Members pause for travel or injury, billing stops.

features.name: Corporate memberships
features.summary: Employers pay for staff memberships with monthly invoicing.

features.name: Card payments
features.summary: Card payments through the payment processor, tokenized.

features.name: Recurring billing engine
features.summary: Charges memberships on schedule, prorates, retries.

notes.text: Three agents have patched proration independently. Needs one owner and a rewrite of the proration module.

features.name: Failed-payment dunning
features.summary: Smart retries and reminder sequence when a card fails.

notes.text: Retries card charges and touches payment data. Security review not done; it is already live for a quarter of studios.
Rollout raised 10% -> 25% after 72h with no errors.

features.name: Invoices & receipts
features.summary: Branded receipts and downloadable invoices.

features.name: Refunds & account credit
features.summary: Full and partial refunds, or credit to the member account.

features.name: Tax handling
features.summary: VAT and sales tax per location, tax-inclusive prices, tax reports.

parts.name: EU VAT rules for digital services

notes.text: Critical path for Payments GA. At this pace it lands Oct 29, a week late. Payout reconciliation and accounting sync wait on it.

features.name: Bank debit (SEPA)

features.summary: Match processor payouts to bookings, fees and refunds.

features.summary: Sell and redeem gift cards online and at the desk.

features.summary: Sell water, mats and merchandise at the front desk.

features.summary: iOS and Android app: book, pay, check in.

features.name: Push notifications
features.summary: Booking confirmations, waitlist promotions, reminders.

features.summary: Membership card in Apple and Google Wallet.

features.name: Member profile
features.summary: Profile, emergency contact, health notes.

features.name: Digital waiver signing
features.summary: Sign the liability waiver before the first class.

features.name: Progress & milestones
features.summary: Streaks, class counts and celebrations.

business.usageNote: Opened by 3% of members who have it switched on.

notes.text: Hypothesis was retention. Usage says nobody looks. Decide: improve or remove.

features.name: Favourites & follow instructors

features.summary: Per-class and per-head rates, payroll file export.

features.summary: Fill rate, retention and ratings per instructor.

features.summary: Two-way sync with instructors' personal calendars.

features.name: Transactional email

features.summary: Text reminders before class and on waitlist promotion.

features.name: Notification preferences
features.summary: Members choose channels and topics.

features.summary: Studios edit the wording and look of every message.

features.name: Email campaigns
features.summary: Newsletters and announcements to member segments.

features.name: Automated journeys
features.summary: Win-back, birthday and lapsed-member sequences.

features.name: Two-way member inbox
features.summary: Members and front desk chat inside the app.

features.name: Promo codes

features.summary: Members invite friends; both get a reward.

features.summary: Revenue by plan, class, instructor and period.

features.name: Attendance & utilisation heatmap
features.summary: Which hours and rooms are full or empty.

features.name: Instructor reports
features.summary: Classes taught, attendance and pay per instructor.

features.name: Churn risk scores
features.summary: Each member scored for risk of leaving, with reasons.

features.name: Custom report builder
features.summary: Studios build their own reports from any field.

features.name: Scheduled report emails
features.summary: Weekly reports delivered to the owner's inbox.

features.name: CSV data export
features.summary: Export members, bookings and payments.

features.name: Public REST API
features.summary: Documented API for studios and partners.

notes.text: Live for 41 partner studios, but rate limiting is still in review. One bad script can hurt everyone.

features.name: Webhooks
features.summary: Events pushed to partner systems.

features.name: Automation connector
features.summary: Connect Kettle to no-code automation platforms.

features.name: Calendar feed (iCal)
features.summary: Members subscribe to their bookings in any calendar.

features.summary: Daily sync of revenue and fees to accounting software.

features.name: Wearables heart-rate
features.summary: Show heart-rate zones from wearables during class.

features.name: Door access control
features.summary: Members unlock the studio door with their app outside staffed hours.

notes.text: Physical access. Needs threat model before any studio gets it.

features.name: Payment terminal
features.summary: Card-present payments at the desk through a terminal.

features.name: Schedule optimizer
features.summary: Suggests timetable changes from fill rates and waitlists.

features.name: Auto-written class descriptions
features.summary: Generates class descriptions from a few keywords.

notes.text: Spec said suggest-then-confirm. Built version overwrites the description directly. Spec drift.

features.name: Churn outreach drafts
features.summary: Drafts a personal message for each at-risk member.

features.name: Operations anomaly alerts
features.summary: Tells owners when bookings or revenue move unusually.

features.name: Chat booking assistant
features.summary: Members book and change classes by chatting.

features.name: Waitlist odds prediction
features.summary: Shows the chance of getting in from the waitlist.

features.name: Multi-tenant data isolation
features.summary: Every query scoped to one studio; no data crosses tenants.

features.name: Background job queue
features.summary: Queue and workers for billing, messages and imports.

notes.text: Queue depth spikes at 06:45 daily when reminders, billing and waitlist all fire.

features.name: File storage & CDN
features.summary: Images, waivers and exports stored and served fast.

features.name: Database backups & point-in-time restore
features.summary: Continuous backups, restore to any minute in 14 days.

features.name: Disaster recovery plan
features.summary: Tested recovery into a second region.

features.name: Rate limiting & abuse protection
features.summary: Limits per key and IP, bot protection on sign-up and booking.

features.name: Feature flag service
features.summary: Per-studio and percentage rollouts for every feature.

features.name: Structured logging
features.summary: Searchable logs with tenant and request ids.

features.name: Distributed tracing
features.summary: Follow one request across API, workers and integrations.

notes.text: Without tracing we cannot see where waitlist and billing jobs slow down.

features.name: Uptime & SLO dashboards
features.summary: Availability and latency objectives per service.

features.name: On-call alerting
features.summary: Paging rules and escalation for the on-call engineer.

features.name: Cloud cost monitoring
features.summary: Cost per service, per feature and per studio.

features.name: GDPR export & erasure
features.summary: Members download or delete their data on request.

features.name: Card data tokenization
features.summary: Card numbers never touch Kettle servers; keeps PCI scope minimal.

features.name: SOC 2 controls
features.summary: Policies, evidence collection and access reviews for SOC 2 Type I.

features.name: Cookie consent
features.summary: Consent banner and preference storage on public pages.

features.name: Data retention policies
features.summary: Automatic deletion of data past its retention period.

features.name: CI pipeline
features.summary: Build, lint, unit tests and security scan on every pull request.

features.name: Preview environments
features.summary: Every pull request gets its own running copy.

features.name: End-to-end test suite
features.summary: Browser tests over the critical member and staff journeys.

notes.text: Covers booking and sign-in. Payments journeys have no browser tests at all.

features.name: Agent sandbox & guardrails
features.summary: Where build agents run, what they may touch, and what needs a human.

notes.text: Guardrails require human review for payments and auth paths. Dunning slipped through via a flag change.

features.name: Release train automation
features.summary: Daily release with automatic promotion through staging.
